test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is:** examine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Examine'** means to inspect or look at closely (जांचना).

 
 
• **Example:** Doctors examine patients to diagnose their diseases.
 
 
 
• **'Examine'** fits the context because paleontologists investigate or look at fossils carefully to understand ancient life. Just as detectives examine clues to solve mysteries, paleontologists examine evidence to unlock the secrets of the past.

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***Examine***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dominate** means to have a commanding influence over; to rule over (वर्चस्व रखना).
 
• **Control **means to command, direct, or rule (नियंत्रण करना).
 
• **Conduct **involves organizing and carrying out something, usually an activity or a procedure (संचालन करना).
